Decision: Create five independent tensile conditions: as-cast, CR, A600, A650, A700.
Scientific_Rationale: All five source states have distinct reported tensile properties under the same reported strain rate.
Implementation_Rule: Each state gets one ML_Condition_ID; replicate_n=3 remains metadata only.

Decision: Only A600 receives verified condition-level TRIP=1/TWIP=1.
Scientific_Rationale: Only A600 has direct post-tensile EBSD/TEM evolution showing FCC→HCP and deformation twins.
Implementation_Rule: As-cast/CR/A650/A700 targets remain NA unless condition-specific post-tensile evidence is later recovered.

Decision: CR processing-induced TRIP/TWIP must not become tensile targets.
Scientific_Rationale: CR already contains deformation twins and 26.1% HCP before its tensile test.
Implementation_Rule: Store Processing_TRIP=1 and Processing_TWIP=1 separately; Effective tensile targets remain NA.

Decision: A600 stage hierarchy uses 0%, 15%, 30%, and fracture as correlated children.
Scientific_Rationale: These are sequential observations of one A600 tensile condition.
Observed twins are explicitly described as annealing twins; deformation-twin activation is directly confirmed only at higher strain.
Implementation_Rule: TRIP=1/TWIP=NA at 15%; 30% and fracture are TRIP=1/TWIP=1.

Decision: Preserve A650 trace HCP 0.1% and single-FCC text/XRD inconsistency.
Scientific_Rationale: EBSD and XRD/text do not report exactly the same phase description.
Implementation_Rule: Use provenance/status rather than silently forcing a consensus.

Decision: Do not assume tensile test temperature.
Scientific_Rationale: No explicit tensile temperature is stated in Methods.
Implementation_Rule: Test_T_K remains NA for all P014 tensile conditions.

Decision: Use replicate_n=3 without pseudo-replicates; ± statistic type remains unknown.
Scientific_Rationale: Three tensile specimens are reported but individual values/statistic definition are not.
Implementation_Rule: Keep condition-level mean ± values, n=3, Replicate_ID=NA.

Decision: Preserve HDI=631.2 MPa as post-loading/model-derived evidence with leakage flag.
Scientific_Rationale: It is obtained from A600 load-unload response and therefore is not a pre-test intrinsic descriptor.
Implementation_Rule: Store in HDI/strengthening table; do not automatically expose it to later predictors.

Scientific_Rationale: No numeric source-specific SFE/DeltaG is reported in P014.
Implementation_Rule: Never import values from another Fe50Mn30Co10Cr10 publication.
